# cloud-cost-analyzer

Analyze FOCUS 1.0 cloud cost CSV exports with Decimal arithmetic: grouped totals by day or month, period comparison and tag coverage. Python package `cloud_cost_analyzer`. MIT licensed. Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Problem, installation, usage.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Library and CLI design.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat model and limits.
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): Suite description.
